title: Read-only Smart Tempo analysis decision trace v1
description: Proposed CI/private-offline research envelope, not an enabled production writer and not a license to export user data

x-privacy.public_ci: only bounded preapproved synthetic IDs, no titles, genres, file paths or raw audio
x-privacy.private_offline: track identifiers and real-audio features stay local and are never committed or uploaded
x-privacy.negative: this schema does not enable collection or emission of production data

x-proof-constraints: Every final nonzero BPM must reference a measured same-analysis candidate
One candidate may have several origin markers; origin is not eligibility
Every exclusion must name its exact stage and reason
Raw-to-cluster parentage must be the exact ordered first-match partition, never an approximate many-to-many BPM join
Every policy FullBoard row must have exactly one unique indexed cluster source; missing sources fail closed
Every native Policy rail verdict must reconcile source-index, resolved BPM and FullBoard membership
Every collapsed candidate's first observed native exclusion must reconcile exact source ID, executed event index, reason and score; absence is not eligibility or a decisive veto
CI-only raw and general-baseline executed comparator ties preserve the four ordered numeric tie fields
CI-only low continuous-center comparator preserves the fifth tie field for source-identity replay
The applied writer resolution must use a fixed native reason enum after the same-run measured-witness invariant; proposed Policy output is not applied writer output
An applied primary or Policy writer source may be indexed only to the actual native selected object; unknown micro-upgrade source identity stays unindexed

Every executed raw or cluster branch-local decisive veto, including nested low-pulse vetoes, must reconcile ordered source ID, reason, native score and event index; no global ineligibility may be inferred
Every collapsed source has one cross-stage observational fate mask reconciling Primary, Policy, writer and branch veto evidence; this is not global eligibility

Every collapsed source additionally conserves raw and cluster selector event counts, first/last executed event positions and first/last branch-local veto positions; no selector event count is proof of global eligibility
Review Hold is a first-class outcome, not counted as a wrong BPM
Window geometry and decoding costs must be independently measured
Ground-truth labels never flow into candidate creation or production selection
Manual merged-export source identity and rank are not Primary selector eligibility; independently replay first-match source grouping and stable sort.
